summaryZh: Kauffman 实验室研究脑与激素如何共同控制哺乳动物生殖，重点是调节 GnRH 神经元的神经回路。团队结合分子、细胞、生理和神经解剖技术及啮齿动物模型，研究成年生育、青春期和性别分化发育。
researchQuestions: 脑与激素如何相互作用，调控哺乳动物的生殖？

evidence.quote: uses a variety of molecular, cellular, physiological and neuroanatomical techniques to study how the brain and hormones interact to control reproduction in mammals.

Our studies use rodent models to examine the regulation of fertility in adulthood as well as the control of the reproductive axis in development, including puberty and critical periods of sexual differentiation.
